name: SamSwat's - Helicopter Crash Sites - Remastered
teaser: SamSwat's Helicopter Crash Sites - DayZ inspired helicrashes now in Tarkov
description_html:
General Information

Original mod by SamSwat

BepInEx plugin that will add random helicopter crash sites. The initial chance is 10%, but it can be adjusted in the configuration manager [F12 key] or alternatively, if you’ve launched up the game at least once with this mod, you can find the com.SamSWAT.HeliCrash.TyrianReboot.cfg file in your BepInEx/config folder and change value there.

If you were lucky, after loading into the raid you may find downed UH-60 Blackhawk by thick column of smoke, its position is random and chosen from HeliCrashLocations.json file, here you can add your own locations or delete them. There should be a container with loot at the rear of the helicopter. It’s just a copy of what was generated for the airdrop so technically there’s no way to alter what will be in the container without affecting airdrops.

- Disclaimer -

Good faith attempt was made to get in contact with SamSwat on 29th October to no avail.

Will be removed upon SamSwat’s request, should he ever return to the SPT Community or otherwise.

Installation

- HOW TO INSTALL:

After you downloaded .zip archive, open it and drag & drop BepInEx folder into your Escape From Tarkov root directory (where EscapeFromTarkov.exe is located).
